predecessor.inherited_gap: 五 frank honest FAIL 的根因=C_F 锚值口径未对齐 + 负阻力区未界定；本单重做并销项
predecessor.structural_root_cause_found_here: the anchor pack contains no measured friction coefficient at all: every C_F in it is an ITTC-57 correlation value, and the recorded (1+k) is definitionally CT/CF_ITTC57, so C_F_exp cannot be extracted without a further assumption -> WITHHELD

C1_anchor_register.statement: anchor register carries >=1 verbatim anchor slot, else honest WITHHELD
C1_anchor_register.experimental_CF_reason: 0 measured-friction entries among the transcribed external quantities; the only C_F entries are ITTC-57 correlation values (grades [A]/[B], rounded) plus the definitional CT/CF double entry

C3_gci.statement: three grids: GCI < 5 % and observed order >= 1.8 at Re = 1.2e7
C3_gci.withheld_reason: a lattice Reynolds number of 1.2e7 is not reachable: the declared compute ceiling of this mission (the cell-updates actually spent on the ladder) is 3.679e+08 cell-updates, while the Re=1.2e7 rung of the reachability table needs 1.460e+22 cell-updates/day-scaled far beyond it (see reachable_reynolds_study)

C4_negative_drag_region.statement: negative-drag region reported in (tau, N) coordinates
C4_negative_drag_region.definition: cell = sign of the window-mean C_T at the given (tau, N); UNSTEADY suffix = last-window drift above the declared 2% steady-state tolerance

boundary.note: bracketed by the scan resolution in tau; the true boundary lies inside the bracket, no interpolation is claimed

C4_negative_drag_region.secondary_excursion_definition: a cell is NEG_EXCURSION if any instantaneous force sample of the run is negative; this is registered separately because the window-mean sign is unstable at the high-Reynolds end of the scan
C4_negative_drag_region.scope_note: the surface covers tau in [0.5002, 0.5072] x N in [32, 48]; a cell is only counted as a sign determination if its last-window drift is inside the declared steady-state tolerance

case_caliber_vs_anchor.case_Re_note: the frozen TensorLBM SUBOFF case fixes the lattice Reynolds number u_lb*N/nu_lb = 1000 (u_lb = 0.05, tau = 0.5072 at N = 48); this is the only Reynolds number the case can substantiate
case_caliber_vs_anchor.caliber_reading: ITTC-57 evaluated at Re=1e3 returns 0.075, i.e. the correlation is carried far outside its fitted range (the line has a pole at Re=100 and is a turbulent flat-plate correlation); it cannot be used as the friction anchor of a Re=1e3 laminar LBM case. This is the structural root cause of the five predecessor honest FAILs.
